RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel may violate university hiring policies, as many public institutions require gender diversity on search committees. However, panel composition alone does not prove sex discrimination. The committee may have genuinely prioritized industry experience, specific subfield fit, or interview performance.

Before alleging bias, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. Check your institution’s recruitment guidelines and consult a faculty union representative or equity officer to determine whether committee diversity rules were breached. If procedural rules were violated or the eventual explanation appears pretextual, you will have legitimate, documented grounds to raise the issue through formal institutional channels.
